definitions.explanation: A payment method in which the buyer pays the courier for the goods at the moment of delivery. Often abbreviated 代引き.

examples.japanese: {支払|しはら}いは{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}にした。
examples.english: I chose cash on delivery for payment.

examples.japanese: {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}は{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかる。
examples.english: Cash on delivery comes with a handling fee.

examples.japanese: {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}なら{商品|しょうひん}を{受|う}け{取|と}るときに{現金|げんきん}で{払|はら}える。
examples.english: With cash on delivery you can pay in cash when you receive the goods.

notes:
Compound of {代金|だいきん} (payment for goods) + {引換|ひきかえ} (exchange). Commonly shortened to {代引|だいび}き in everyday speech and online shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}で{払|はら}う: to pay by cash on delivery
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}{手数料|てすうりょう}: the COD handling fee
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}を{利用|りよう}する: to use cash on delivery
